data-table.label: DataTable list
data-table.usedFor: Browsing many records of one entity.
anatomyNotes: Title and primary action live in the table-card header, not in PageHeader.
Card is rounded-lg border bg-card; header is px-4 py-3 border-b.
thead uses bg-muted/40; th is px-4 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground.
Selection column is w-8, action column is w-0 text-right, checkboxes use --accent-indigo.
Pagination copy reads 'Showing 1 to 25 of 312 results' with tabular-nums.
Bulk actions stay inline in the toolbar - the floating dark bar belongs to Kanban.

crud-form.label: CrudForm
anatomyNotes: Grid is grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[7fr_3fr] gap-4 with two space-y-3 columns.
A group card is rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-3 space-y-3; its title is text-sm font-medium.
In edit mode FormHeader puts Back and the title left, actions right.
Footer order is fixed: additional actions, then Delete, then Cancel, then Save.
Save is a submit button with a Save icon; while saving use Loader2 animate-spin and 'Saving…'.
Delete uses destructive-outline, never full destructive.

kanban.label: Kanban pipeline
anatomyNotes: Column header is rounded-lg bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3.5 with a h-1.5 accent bar above it.
Column name is text-sm font-bold uppercase with a count badge; stage total sits right.
A card is rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-3.5 shadow-xs; title is text-base font-semibold line-clamp-2.
Chips are rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold using status-* tokens.
Quick actions may reveal on hover but must stay reachable by touch and keyboard focus.
The bulk-action bar is fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-foreground text-background.

detail-drawer.label: Drawer or dialog
detail-drawer.usedFor: Inspecting or confirming without leaving the list.
anatomyNotes: A drawer and a dialog are each a distinct review state in the inventory, not a variant of the list.
Must not clip at a narrow viewport - the skill verifies this in both themes.
Keyboard traversal and visible focus are required, not optional polish.

tokenRules: Use semantic tokens only; express status with status-{error|success|warning|info|neutral|pink}-{bg|text|border|icon}.
Never add dark: overrides - the semantic tokens already switch themes.
Never hardcode a Tailwind shade or an arbitrary value.
tokens.css is generated from apps/mercato/src/app/globals.css and is never hand-edited.

controlScale.defaultButton: h-9 px-4 py-2 (px-3 with an icon)
